summary: Air Industries Group filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its merger agreement with Tenax Aerospace Acquisition, LLC, extending the Outside Date from September 30, 2026 to November 30, 2026. The merger agreement provides customary termination rights if closing does not occur by the Outside Date. This is a transaction extension, not a new deal. The filing includes the amendment as an exhibit and a press release. The extension may signal potential deal risk; watch for further extensions, termination, or closing progress before the new deadline.
